{{Short description|Blu-ray collection}}
'''''Looney Tunes Collector's Vault''''' is a series of 2-disc [[Blu-ray]]s from [[Warner Bros. Home Entertainment]]'s [[Warner Archive Collection|Warner Archive]] division collecting various ''[[Looney Tunes]]'' and ''[[Merrie Melodies]]'' theatrical animated short subjects from [[Warner Bros. Cartoons]]. It is the spiritual successor to the ''[[Looney Tunes Collector's Choice]]'' Blu-ray series.

Unlike the previous ''Collector's Choice'' series - which only contained a single disc with 25 cartoons - ''Collector's Vault'' contains two discs with 50 cartoons (51 on ''Volume 2''). Usually, the first disc would contain 25 shorts never-before-remastered on DVD or Blu-ray, while the second disc would contain 25 shorts previously released on DVD making their Blu-ray debut.

''Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 1'' was announced on March 13, 2025<ref name=V1Announcement /> and released on June 17, 2025.<ref name="Miller III">{{cite web |last1=Miller III |first1=Randy |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 1 Blu-ray Review |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/movies/Looney-Tunes-Collectors-Vault-Volume-1-Blu-ray/384090/#Review |website=Blu-Ray.com |access-date=10 June 2025}}</ref> The first disc contains 24 shorts never-before-released on DVD or Blu-ray in restored form. In addition, ''[[Double or Mutton]]'' (1955), which was previously released as part of ''[[Looney Tunes Collector's Choice#Volume 4|Collector's Choice: Volume 4]]'', is also included on this set. According to [[Jerry Beck]] and George Feltenstein, this was a mistake; they apologized for its inclusion, and promised fans that the first disc of ''Volume 2'' would include 26 cartoons to make up for the double dip.<ref name="Extras Vol. 1 Reveal">{{cite web |last1=Millard |first1=Tim |title=Introducing Looney Tunes Collector's Vault Vol. 1 |url=https://podcasts.apple.com/au/podcast/introducing-looney-tunes-collectors-vault-vol-1/id1567580798?i=1000704784952 |website=The Extras |publisher=Apple Podcasts |access-date=28 April 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Millard |first1=Tim |title=Introducing the #LooneyTunes Collector's Vault V1 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFfheohtBZg&t=210s |website=The Extras TV |publisher=YouTube |access-date=28 April 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Millard |first1=Tim |title=Details You Want to Know About the Upcoming #LooneyTunes Collector's Vault V1 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N1l8oSfgIIc&t=98s |website=The Extras |date=March 25, 2025 |publisher=YouTube |access-date=23 April 2025}}</ref>

Much like ''Collector's Choice: Volume 4'', only three cartoons were specifically restored for this set: ''[[A Day at the Zoo]]'' (1939), ''[[Of Fox and Hounds]]'' (1940) and ''[[Each Dawn I Crow]]'' (1949). The other 21 new cartoons on disc one are all restorations previously done for [[HBO Max]] and [[MeTV]], with Warner Archive correcting the [[Photoshopped]] title cards.<ref name="Thad">{{cite web |last1=Komorowski |first1=Thad |title=The Thad Review: "Looney Tunes: Collector's Vault Vol. 1" |url=https://cartoonresearch.com/index.php/the-thad-review-looney-tunes-collectors-vault-vol-1/ |website=Cartoon Research |access-date=10 June 2025}}</ref>

The second disc contains 25 cartoons previously restored and released on the various ''[[Looney Tunes Golden Collection]]'' and ''[[Looney Tunes Super Stars]]'' DVD sets, as well as ''[[The Essential Daffy Duck]]'', but having not yet been released on Blu-ray. One cartoon, ''[[Tom Turk and Daffy]]'' (1944), received new, improved color grading from its original release on the ''[[Looney Tunes Super Stars' Porky & Friends: Hilarious Ham]]'' DVD.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Millard |first1=Tim |title=Warner Archive Unveils Looney Tunes Collector's Vault PLUS Two January Blu-ray Reviews |url=https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/warner-archive-unveils-looney-tunes-collectors-vault/id1567580798?i=1000700161143 |website=The Extras |publisher=Apple Podcasts |access-date=23 April 2025}}</ref><ref name="Thad" /><ref name=V1Announcement>{{Cite web |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=36122 |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 1 Blu-ray |access-date=July 16, 2026 |website=www.blu-ray.com}}</ref> Disc two of ''Collector's Vault: Volume 1'' did not carry over any of the [[audio commentaries]] and alternate audio tracks made for the ''Golden Collections''.

''Volume 1'' contains the following cartoons:<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=36373 |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 1 Blu-ray |access-date=July 16, 2026 |website=www.blu-ray.com}}</ref>

''Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 2'' was officially announced on December 23, 2025 and released on March 24, 2026, having been delayed from an original December 2025 release due to Warner Archive focusing its efforts on ''[[Tom and Jerry: The Golden Era Anthology]]''.<ref name="Vol. 2 Reveal">{{cite web|title= Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 2 Blu-ray|url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=37641|website=Blu-Ray.com|date=December 23, 2025|access-date=December 24, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Millard |first1=Tim |title=EXCLUSIVE! Looney Tunes Collector's Vault Volume 2 UPDATE! |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sM3Vv4UG0Eo |website=The Extras TV |publisher=YouTube |access-date=8 November 2025}}</ref>

The first disc contains 26 shorts never-before-released on DVD or Blu-ray in restored form, one more than the previous volume in order to make up for the mistaken inclusion of ''[[Double or Mutton]]'' (1955). Only four cartoons were restored specifically for this set: ''[[A-Lad-In His Lamp]]'' (1948), ''[[Ain't That Ducky]]'' (1945), ''[[The Daffy Duckaroo]]'' (1942), and ''[[I Taw a Putty Tat]]'' (1948). The other 22 cartoons on disc one - including ''[[Little Blabbermouse]]'' (1940), which was originally included as an unrestored bonus short on the ''[[Looney Tunes Mouse Chronicles: The Chuck Jones Collection]]'' Blu-ray and DVD sets - are all restorations previously done for [[HBO Max]] and [[MeTV]], with Warner Archive correcting the [[Photoshopped]] title cards. In addition ''[[The Rattled Rooster]]'' (1948) had its original opening title sequence restored, as opposed to the [[List of Warner Bros. cartoons with Blue Ribbon reissues|Blue Ribbon]] reissue titles featured on previous releases.<ref name="Vol. 2 Review">{{Cite web|url=https://www.blu-ray.com/movies/Looney-Tunes-Collectors-Vault-Volume-2-Blu-ray/403480/ |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 2 Blu-ray (Warner Archive Collection) |access-date=March 25, 2026 |website=blu-ray.com}}</ref>

As with the previous volume, the second disc contains 25 cartoons previously restored and released on the various ''[[Looney Tunes Golden Collection]]'' and ''[[Looney Tunes Super Stars]]'' DVD sets, but having not yet been released on Blu-ray. One cartoon, ''[[Hop and Go]]'' (1943) - which was previously released as an unrestored extra on ''[[Looney Tunes Golden Collection: Volume 6]]'' - uses the restored print with the uncensored ending that first aired on [[MeTV+]], with the stereo mix being removed. Disc two of ''Collector's Vault: Volume 2'' also carried over five of the audio commentaries from the ''Golden Collection'' series.<ref name="Vol. 2 Review" />

Due to the [[politically incorrect]] nature of cartoons such as ''A-Lad-In His Lamp'' and ''The Daffy Duckaroo'', both discs begin with the standard "products of their time" disclaimer - first introduced on the ''[[Looney Tunes Golden Collection: Volume 4]]'' DVD set in 2006.<ref>{{cite web |last1=E |first1=Timmothy |title=Looney Tunes Collector's Vault Volume 2 Blu-Ray Review |url=https://www.hometheaterforum.com/looney-tunes-collectors-vault-volume-2-blu-ray-review/ |website=Home Theater Forum |access-date=8 April 2026}}</ref>

''Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 3'' was announced on July 9, 2026 and released on September 8, 2026.<ref name="Vol. 3 Reveal">{{cite web|title= Looney Tunes Collector's Vault: Volume 3 Blu-ray |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/news/?id=38669|website=Blu-Ray.com|date=July 9, 2026|access-date=July 9, 2026}}</ref>

The first disc contains 25 cartoons never-before-released on DVD or Blu-ray in restored form, including both ''[[Sinkin' in the Bathtub]]'' (1930) and ''[[Lady, Play Your Mandolin!]]'' (1931), the first ''[[Looney Tunes]]'' and ''[[Merrie Melodies]]'' cartoons, respectively. Only five cartoons were restored specifically for this set: ''[[A Feather in His Hare]]'' (1948), ''[[Horse Hare]]'' (1960), ''[[Nothing But the Tooth]]'' (1948), the aforementioned ''Sinkin' in the Bathtub'' - which was previously released as an unrestored extra on ''[[Looney Tunes Golden Collection: Volume 3]]'' and ''[[Looney Tunes Platinum Collection: Volume 2]]'', and ''[[Slightly Daffy]]'' (1944). The other 20 cartoons on disc one, including some of those initially released as unrestored extras on other official ''Looney Tunes'' DVD and Blu-ray sets, are all restorations previously done for [[HBO Max]] and [[MeTV]].<ref name="Vol. 3 Reveal" />

As with the first two volumes, the second disc contains 25 cartoons previously restored and released on the various ''[[Looney Tunes Golden Collection]]'' and ''[[Looney Tunes Super Stars]]'' DVD sets, but having not yet been released on Blu-ray. Similar to ''Volume 2'', disc two of ''Volume 3'' carried over five of the audio commentaries from the ''Golden Collection'' DVDs.<ref name="Vol. 3 Reveal" />

''Volume 3'' contains the following cartoons:<ref name="Vol. 3 Reveal" />
